traits.notes: The seedling exhibits heteroblasty, with some leaves appearing simple and lobed (possibly juvenile) while others are clearly pinnately compound (mature). This is a common trait in several tropical families, including Fabaceae. The leaves show signs of damage, including holes and missing sections of the margin.
